scope: Fourteen separate side-view candidates, seven recovered and seven new/corrected. Existing portraits, source roles, prior poses and clips retained.

imports.review: Right-facing full-body silhouette retains the bent torso, long black hair, three exterior arms, lowered original knife and two complete feet visible in the native references.
imports.limits: The bent torso and hidden-side geometry are authored reconstructions. No source timing or exact anatomy is certified. Requested generous padding is not met on all sides: minimum visible padding is 4.35%; every readable extremity remains inside the native canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Right-facing natural crouched/resting form matches the plain-body art sheet: curved spine, long folded legs, extended forearms and fingers, and pink cranial filaments. No floral-overgrown variant or extended tongue is mixed in.
imports.limits: Source-native posture is low and crouched. Height is a provisional native-idle envelope calibration, not a canonical standing-equivalent measurement; review at gameplay scale before accepting final animation calibration. Requested generous padding is not met on all sides: minimum visible padding is 3.09%; every readable extremity remains inside the native canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Clean right-facing profile preserves the bald cavernous head, gaunt body, hip wrapping, collar and lock, wrist and ankle shackles, dangling chain ends and branches. Whole hands and feet are visible.
imports.limits: Hidden-side geometry and exact surface markings are reconstructed. Standing idle only; no source movement timings or 1:1 certification. Requested generous padding is not met on all sides: minimum visible padding is 2.93%; every readable extremity remains inside the native canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Right-facing whole ceramic doll form retains the Okame-style mask, white hair with twigs, colored forearms, ball-joint hips, original curved knife and two tapered blade legs.
imports.limits: Source-guided side reconstruction with far-side overlap. No certification of hidden joints or exact blade dimensions; one static idle only. Requested generous padding is not met on all sides: minimum visible padding is 5.08%; every readable extremity remains inside the native canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Whole right-facing drum body preserves top membranes, mouth drum with tomoe pattern, flower/root surface, rope and bells, spiked club arm and twisted bachi arm. Both feet and complete arm tips are visible.
imports.limits: Native front/back sheets require an authored side projection. Exact concealed drum surfaces are inferred, not certified; no animated strike or sound event is added. Requested generous padding is not met on all sides: minimum visible padding is 4.00%; every readable extremity remains inside the native canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Whole right-facing base form matches the leftmost artbook form: tall wataboshi, patterned mask, layered ivory wedding kimono, tassels, two original small hands, full sleeves and trailing train.
imports.limits: Base form only. Giant transformed arms, attack forms and animation are not supplied. Feet are deliberately not invented; anchor y uses the complete resting hem. Requested generous padding is not met on all sides: minimum visible padding is 4.20%; every readable extremity remains inside the native canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: One complete connected source entity with exactly three mottled brown jointed tubes and three distinct circular mouths, directed right from a small common base. No invented walking body, limbs or additional tube.
imports.limits: Reference-only lateral dossier. Preserve environmental-obstacle and combatEnabled=false: the SH1 room-204 puzzle creature does not acquire a duel kit or locomotion. Source-side projection and finer texture remain unverified. Low-alpha noise up to 1 can reach canvas edges; no trimming, recoloring, rescaling or background cleanup was applied.

imports.review: Exactly two native lower supports now visible; the third foot has been removed. One connected whole right-facing creature, floral crown, knife and opposite curled tubular arm retained.
imports.limits: Head projection and concealed floral details remain reconstructed; native margins are smaller than requested, but all readable extremities fit.

imports.review: Exactly eight separate articulated hands are visible, four on each side of the single robe-clad body; missing far-side lowest arm restored. Full profile faces right with complete feet, masks and hair.
imports.limits: The side reconstruction remains unverified; phase weapons and source animation are not supplied. All readable extremities fit inside native image.

references.provenance: Official Silent Hill: Ascension concept sheet bearing Konami copyright, retained from prior session through Silent Hill Memories mirror. Visually inspected this session; original source bytes copied unchanged.

imports.review: Profil droit en pied inspecté : quatre bras terminés par quatre crochets lisibles, deux jambes et masque pâle fermé. Les membranes sont partiellement repliées et étagées pour une lecture latérale.
imports.limits: Reconstruction latérale depuis une planche concept promotionnelle. L’attribution du concept au Stinger reste candidate dans le registre historique ; géométrie masquée, disposition exacte des membranes et orientation du masque non certifiées. Une seule pose statique. Fidélité 1:1 non validée. Portrait antérieur à préserver.

imports.review: Whole connected golden fox form in right-facing lateral idle. Long narrow muzzle, upright ears, red eye, cream chest mane, four complete leg supports (near/far front legs overlap), pale shoulder ribbons and golden tail fan retained. Every readable outer extremity stays inside the image.
imports.limits: This is the golden fully furred artwork phase, not the red patched phase. Tail fan overlap and rear root-to-tip continuity are reconstructed and not certified. The original airborne art was adapted into a static four-foot idle; source timing and exact hidden geometry remain unverified. Requested 10% padding is not met: minimum visible padding is 1.91%. Readable extremities remain inside the canvas. Low-alpha noise up to 1-2 reaches some borders; native pixels are retained without trimming, background cleanup, rescaling or recoloring.
